source: Philippine Statistics Authority, 2024 Census of Population (reference date 1 July 2024), via OpenSTAT tables 0041A6DTPH3 (municipal totals) and 0201A6DPAG0 (household population by age, province)
method: Adults 18+ per municipality = 2024 total population x Laguna's 18+ share of household population (0.7094); ages 18-19 are 2/5 of the 15-19 band. Age-group shares from the same Laguna table.
caveat: PSA publishes age groups by province, not by municipality, so every municipality gets Laguna's adult share.
